scope: Bounded synthetic IME event/focus follow-up; no GUI, native system IME, Windows, CI or full build run
checks: late and duplicate final input notification after proxy cleared

failureEvidence.unit.log: Initial test authoring error: newly declared tests accidentally inside setup; corrected before behavioral evaluation. 12 existing IME tests failed collection during runtime; 6 adjacent boundary tests passed.
failureEvidence.unit-final.log: Real regression: windowed commit after blur steals focus in both orders. 24 passed/2 failed. Text and history assertions passed.

fix: Only composition commit passes focusInput=false through private SourceDocumentView.applyTextInput/applyVisibleEdit; input identity is stable, so current native focus is retained without explicit focus. Other editing call sites preserve previous default.
limitations: Synthetic CompositionEvent/InputEvent with actual jsdom focus changes; not real operating-system IME or candidate window validation.
A late input notification describes the committed DOM mutation and does not artificially refill the cleared input; browser-specific new DOM mutation after compositionend is not proven here.
No new browser matrix run; prior 16-case Chromium CDP evidence remains separately frozen.
